answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a heartbeat stop fake identities. Each agent registers a cipher key and must answer a beacon challenge within 90 seconds; a missed check freezes the identity like a glacier, halting earnings. Checks arrive randomly, bending like a willow, so a bot farm cannot pre-compute answers. Running 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 machines at $0.02 an hour, about $480 a day, while one honest agent pays $0.02 and keeps its full share.
